text:
Sam (People Ops): Quick heads-up  we open the 2026 compliance/attestation window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Two asks: (A) every employee completes the 15-min privacy microtraining, (B) each team uploads at least one SOC2-relevant artifact OR files a ticket assigning an evidence owner.
Sam (People Ops): Upload path: /attestations/2026/<team>/ or use the attestation portal: https://intranet.redwood.ai/attestations. Deadline: 2026-06-12 17:00 PT.
Ivy (Security): Audit note: auditors accept owner-assigned tickets as interim evidence but may sample teams for deeper artifacts. If sampled, we'll request logs, IAM exports, key rotation, or backup manifests.
Noah (Eng): What counts as a valid artifact?
Sam (People Ops): Short list: runbooks, IAM export CSV, scheduled-backup manifest, KMS/key rotation export, change control ticket with approvals. If unsure, open a ticket `TEAM - Attestation 2026 - owner: <name>` and mark `evidence: pending`.
Aisha (Data): For data team, do we need to redact datasets before upload?
Ivy (Security): Yes redact PII or provide internal IDs. If you need help, tag @Legal or open a redaction assistance ticket.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: microtraining assigned: "Privacy Refresher 2026" 1-min estimated completion. Link: https://learning.redwood.ai/course/privacy-refresher-2026
Sam (People Ops): Extension policy: teams with production rollouts may request a 48-72h scoped extension. Create a ticket titled `Compliance extension - <team> - <reason>` and CC @Ivy.
Noah (Eng): We're deploying Wed morning. I'll file for a 48h extension for eng.
Compliance Bot: Auto-reminders scheduled: 72h and 48h before deadline. Teams missing items will get DMs and an @here nudge in #people-ops.
Aisha (Data): I'll upload our IAM export and a short doc explaining data access owners today.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks  we'll post a 24h and final 6h reminder. If anyone wants a quick walkthrough, office hours Thu 11:00 PT with Security.
Onboarding Bot: Pinning resources: checklist, upload guide, redaction tips.
